type: Return a `Type` wrapping `value`, exposing `is*()` predicates to test its runtime type across realms.
Type.isArrayBuffer: Whether the value is an `ArrayBuffer`, whether or not it can be detached. A `SharedArrayBuffer` is not one; see `isSharedArrayBuffer()`.
Type.isDetachableArrayBuffer: Whether the value is an `ArrayBuffer` that can be detached, such as with `transfer()`. The buffer of a `WebAssembly.Memory` can't be. A buffer that is already detached still counts. Added in v1.5.0.
Type.isMapIterator: Whether the value is an iterator over a `Map`, such as the one `entries()`, `keys()`, or `values()` of a `Map` returns. Added in v1.6.0.
Type.isSetIterator: Whether the value is an iterator over a `Set`, such as the one `entries()`, `keys()`, or `values()` of a `Set` returns. Added in v1.6.0.
